params.prompt: Edit this exact Astrid casino photograph as a precise motion keyframe. Preserve her face, gaze, hair, black jacket with full length sleeves to both wrists, ivory blouse, body proportions, lighting, camera crop, table markings and existing card shoe pixel composition. Change ONLY her forearms/hands and add ONE normal playing card to show the instant immediately AFTER a compact professional blackjack card turnover beside the shoe. The WHITE PRINTED FACE of the card is face-up, almost flat on the green felt immediately to the LEFT of the LOW FRONT OUTLET of the existing shoe (viewer coordinates), no more than one card width away from the mouth. Her receiving RIGHT hand (entering from viewer left) reaches across LOW and holds the card's trailing edge against the felt with index/middle fingertips; thumb naturally supports the edge, not a hovering hand. Her feeding LEFT hand at viewer right has just released that same card and rests beside the outlet. Both hands are adjacent beside the shoe, elbows and wrists low, relaxed shoulders. Card is NOT upright, NOT shown to camera, NOT at the centre of her body, NOT already down at the betting arc. This is a compact low post-turn pose before the outward dealing slide. Exactly one rectangular queen of spades, no extra cards outside shoe, no changes to sleeve length, table or identity.
